commits.message: Research BrowserSkill as narrow CAP browser provider
Research: preserve full BrowserSkill capability target

pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Research whether Tencent BrowserSkill can become a **full-capability Browser provider family under CAP authority** for real logged-in Chromium use, while preserving CAP authorization/verification.

Stage Research decision: **NARROW — implementation sequence only**.

This does **not** mean "trim BrowserSkill to a tiny subset". The research now carries an explicit capability-preservation contract: every BrowserSkill feature family stays visible as `FIRST_SLICE`, `TRACKED_NEXT`, `BLOCKED_WITH_REASON`, or `REJECTED_BY_REVIEWED_DECISION`. Omission from an early experiment cannot silently become a permanent product boundary.

## Long-horizon direction

```text
ordinary ChatGPT
 -> CAP semantic / consequence surface
 -> CAP Control Plane / Browser capability
 -> BrowserSkill provider
 -> real Chromium profile
```

Playwright remains an accepted isolated provider, but BrowserSkill is not defined as a permanently reduced fallback.

## Capability preservation

The tracked target inventory now explicitly includes:

- session start/stop/list;
- navigation/history/wait;
- observe/snapshot/HTML/screenshot/console/network;
- click/fill/hover/wheel/scroll/focus/blur/select/press;
- tab list/create/select/close;
- **borrow existing user tab + return** as a core authenticated-browser target;
- resize/emulation;
- request-help / human handoff;
- upload/drop-upload/download;
- multiple connected browsers and explicit instance/profile selection;
- remote/server mode;
- evaluate/raw page script;
- record/trace capture;
- BrowserSkill audit/effect metadata.

Nothing in that inventory is rejected by this brief. Higher-authority items can be blocked pending security/authority research, but they stay tracked.

The current CAP six-tool surface is also explicitly **not an eternal ceiling**. If tabs, file transfer, human assistance or another BrowserSkill consequence class cannot be represented truthfully through current semantics, CAP should review a truthful public-surface extension instead of hiding or deleting the capability.

## First executable slice

The first physical proof is intentionally small only to isolate failures:

```text
CAP
 -> BrowserSkill-created Agent Window
 -> navigate
 -> observe
 -> one bounded interaction
 -> observe again
 -> CAP verification
 -> stop
```

That first slice is **not the product boundary**. The next acceptance slice is required to address existing-user-tab borrow/return and its denial/timeout/crash/cleanup behavior once the local peer-authentication and lifecycle gates are satisfied.

## Important security finding

BrowserSkill v0.3.0 is pinned to exact upstream commit
`75e2c64abaf4b7cc75682d94b0c1fd5db0cbd5e5`.

Its local WebSocket peer gate accepts any extension-shaped Chrome origin rather than authenticating the exact BrowserSkill extension. Open upstream reports #273/#118 document the same boundary. That blocks **production logged-in-profile authority** until resolved, but it is recorded as a security block, not a rejection of BrowserSkill capabilities.

## Scope

Research/documentation only. No runtime, dependency, public tool, authority implementation or release ordering is changed.

This PR does not displace the current roadmap or PR #159. Any implementation invocation must rerun repository bootstrap against the then-live repository state, and every later BrowserSkill integration PR must update the capability matrix so features cannot disappear by omission.
pull_request.title: Research: BrowserSkill under CAP with full capability preservation
